title: When the Escarpment Turns
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Tamsin Marchetti, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
